name: Slavyana Yaseneva Maksimovna
source:
Born May 12th, 1971 in Omsk. 

Nothing notable was discovered in her biography. She attended secondary school, was a diligent daughter and a Pioneer. Like many children at the time, she dreamt of joining the communist party. 

At the age of 20, married a son of a politician who was a friend of her father's. 

Lost her life in a car accident at the age of 25. 

[Based on the in-game profile]
